about: Sound occlusion rules shared by the game (index.html OCC / occlude()) and the Unity port. mat: [dB, low-pass Hz] by the blocking solid's material; thick: extra dB per metre beyond ref (capped at max); around: a route round a corner / through a doorway exists -> played from its first visible corner with these numbers (+ perM x extra route metres, low-pass from lp to lpFar over maxExtra m), level kept to the whole route; over: a waist-high obstacle only takes the top off; budget: rays / route searches per frame, answers cached per cell m of source position for ttl s.
